text: Your board is still here. ♟️ You do not need a winning streak to get back into chess. Start with one free AI game. Today’s focus: before each move, find one undefended piece — yours or your opponent’s. Notice how often that changes your decision. Choose AI practice in Play. After the game, check your progress in Challenges. One useful game is a good return.
